description: Поиск заголовка по содержимому через перечисление ячеек
code:
import pandas as pd
months = ["Янв", "Фев", "Мар", "Апр", "Май", "Июн", "Июл", "Авг", "Сен"]
book = pd.read_excel("zerno_finance.xlsx", sheet_name=["План", "Факт"], header=None)
heads = {}
sums = {}
for name, sheet in book.items():
    row = next(i for i, v in enumerate(sheet.iloc[:, 0]) if v == "Код")
    heads[name] = int(row)
    t = pd.read_excel("zerno_finance.xlsx", sheet_name=name, skiprows=row)
    t = t[t["Код"] != "Итого"].set_index("Код")
    sums[name] = t[months].sum(axis=1)
pf = pd.DataFrame({"план": sums["План"], "факт": sums["Факт"]}).round(1)
print(heads)

description: Высоты листов переписаны из единственной книги
code:
import pandas as pd
months = ["Янв", "Фев", "Мар", "Апр", "Май", "Июн", "Июл", "Авг", "Сен"]
book = pd.read_excel("zerno_finance.xlsx", sheet_name=["План", "Факт"], header=None)
heads = {}
sums = {}
for name, sheet in book.items():
    row = {"План": 3, "Факт": 4}[name]
    heads[name] = int(row)
    t = pd.read_excel("zerno_finance.xlsx", sheet_name=name, skiprows=row)
    t = t[t["Код"] != "Итого"].set_index("Код")
    sums[name] = t[months].sum(axis=1)
pf = pd.DataFrame({"план": sums["План"], "факт": sums["Факт"]}).round(1)
print(heads)
